name: Tally: export Balance Sheet and e-mail it
description: Runs tally_balance_sheet_export.json, then mails the exported XML as an attachment - through Outlook (default: opens a draft for you to check; set send_now to send directly) or through Gmail SMTP with an App Password stored via `autoflow secret set gmail`.

steps.comment: Shares its variables back, so ${export_path} and ${export_file} are available here

steps.name: body
steps.value: Dear Sir/Madam,${newline}${newline}Please find attached the Balance Sheet exported from TallyPrime on ${now}.${newline}${newline}Regards,${newline}AutoFlowMate

then.subject: ${subject}
then.comment: send_now false = opens the mail in Outlook for you to check and press Send

else.subject: ${subject}
else.comment: Store the Gmail App Password once: autoflow secret set gmail
